mainEntity.name: What is the cost range for granite countertop installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of granite countertop installation varies widely, typically ranging from $40 to $100 per square foot, including materials and labor. This range is influenced by the specific type and rarity of granite chosen, the complexity of the design (e.g., cutouts for sinks, cooktops, intricate edges), the amount of material needed, and any necessary demolition of existing countertops. For an accurate estimate, we provide a detailed quote after an on-site measurement and material selection. This ensures transparency and helps you budget effectively for your project in your Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Dublin, Emeryville home.
